messages.subject: optimization of a graph including multiple plots in one page, with  codes
parts:
Dear ggplot2-ers,

I want to draw a graph with multiple plots arranged one by one in one page.

I am now struggling with optimization of this kind of graph, but I
have gotten very few progresses. The plots look narrow, unreadable and
uncoordinated in the page.

I want to know how to set the R-graphics' parameters so as to change
the graph into a nice and beautiful one.

Also, I want to know whether and how this work can be implemented
with ggplot2.

dummy data and codes followed here:

# dummy data
factor<-rep(c("Alice","Jone","Mike"),each=100)
factor<-factor(factor)
traits1<-c(rnorm(100, mean=1, sd=1), rnorm(100, mean=3, sd=3),

rnorm(100, mean=6, sd=6))
traits20<-c(rnorm(100, mean=1, sd=1), rnorm(100, mean=3, sd=3),
rnorm(100, mean=6, sd=6))
traits21<-c(rnorm(100, mean=1, sd=1), rnorm(100, mean=3, sd=3),
rnorm(100, mean=6, sd=6))

myda<-data.frame(factor,traits1,traits2,traits3,traits4,traits5,traits6,traits7,traits8,traits9,traits10,traits11,traits12,traits13,traits14,traits15,traits16,traits17,traits18,
traits19,traits20,traits21)

# density plot
pdf("densityPlot.pdf")
op <- par(mfrow=c(3,7), oma=c(1,1,1,1))
for (i in 2:22 ){
plot(density(myda[ ,i]), ylim= c(0,
1.25*max(max(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Alice")])$y),

max(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Jone")])$y),

max(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Mike")])$y))),
bty="n",
yaxt="n",xlab=names(myda)[i], ylab="", type="n", main="",
zero.line=FALSE)
lines(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Alice")]), lwd=2,col=2)
lines(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Jone")]), lwd=2,col=3)
lines(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Mike")]), lwd=2,col=4)
polygon(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Alice")]), col =
rgb(1,0,0,0.5))
polygon(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Jone")]), col =
rgb(0,1,0,0.5))
polygon(density(myda[,i][myda$factor==c("Mike")]), col =
rgb(0,0,1,0.5))
legend("topright", legend = c("Alice", "Jone", "Mike"),
col=2:4, pch=22, title= "Students", bty= "n")

}
dev.off()

messages.subject: Re: optimization of a graph including multiple plots in one page,  with codes
parts:
Hi,

Try this,


library(ggplot2)
d = melt(myda, id = "factor")

str(d)

p =
ggplot(data=d, mapping=aes(x=value, y=..density..)) +
facet_wrap(~variable)+
stat_density(aes(fill=factor), alpha=0.5, col=NA, position = 'identity') +
stat_density(aes(colour = factor), geom="path", position = 'identity')

print(p)

HTH,


baptiste
